# Monti

> Monti is an independent designer creating cover art and Spotify Canvas loops for
> musicians. Work is delivered ready for streaming, social media and print,
> with up to 3 revision rounds included on every project.

## About

Monti (Monti Moltisanti) designs the visuals for music releases, starting with
the cover people see before they hear the song. Clients work directly with the
designer, with no agency or middleman in between. Files arrive in the right
sizes and formats for Spotify, Apple Music, social platforms and print.

## Services and pricing (EUR)

- Cover Art Design: from €150. Single, EP or album artwork.
- Animation / Visualizer: from €300. Spotify Canvas loops (3–8 s) or YouTube loops, in 1080p or 4K.
- Full Visual Identity (Album): custom quote. Cover art, tracklist and promo graphics, social media assets and Spotify Canvas for the lead singles.

Prices are starting points. The exact quote depends on scope and deadline and is
confirmed before the project starts. Every project includes up to 3 revision rounds.

## Process

1. Send the brief: the song, references and deadline.
2. We shape it: the designer works through up to 3 revision rounds with you.
3. You release: high-res masters plus exports sized for every platform.
